previousGenericRiverLayer.note: Old river-buildings.js is a comparison reference only; the generic renderer now uses cityBuildings.

sources.name: Qian Shi et al. East Asian buildings
Published landmark heights and core OSM floor counts

heightPolicy: Published/known OSM measurements and floor counts take priority. Missing heights use a deterministic weighted median of nine nearby, similarly sized known buildings, with footprint/use caps. Small roofs and heritage types use explicit low-rise estimates. No random heights.
deduplicationPolicy: Current full-extent OSM first. Exclude retained detailed-core IDs and substantial overlaps, authored landmarks, non-building roofs/bridges/elevators, water-only features and tiny clipped fragments. Overture fills non-overlapping gaps. Walking paths do not cause building removal.
limits: Counts refer to available GIS footprint features and clipped polygon components, not a verified present-day census of all physical buildings.
ML roofprints may contain omissions, classification errors or split roofs. Source update dates do not establish imagery capture dates.
Most building heights remain estimated; this is not survey-grade 3D reconstruction.
Existing detailed-core buildings and authored landmarks are rendered by their own modules and are excluded from the new footprint layer.
